answer: Sybil Guard: 1. New identities stake $100. 2. Existing identities stake $10 to challenge. 3. A timed review validates or invalidates challenges. If valid, the challenged identity loses their stake; if invalid, the challenger loses theirs. Cost to challenge N identities: $10 N^2. Failure: A group controls >50% stake. This system functions like an ivory tower overseeing an oasis, where a falcon's keen sight protects the integrity of the resources.
